lodash, 19,595 B on the notestutorial-main page: the full build; lodash-es with named imports ships only what is used.
838,601 B in 3 pieces of 2 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (87 packages, 494 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
